geeklist.title: The "x + 1" game buyer's Auction for Canada & US
geeklist.description:
How many games should you have? The correct answer is, of course, x+1 where x is the number of games you currently own. But, as many here will tell you, this philosophy can bite you in the bum. So here we are.
[b][size=18]Monday Jan 26th: All minimum bids have dropped by at least $20[/size][/b]
[b]All games that have been opened are complete with very little use. All stored in smoke-free and pet-free environment.[/b]
[b][u]Auction Details.[/u][/b]
1. All currency in CAD. Any US conversions will be done day of shipping. Winning bidder pays shipping. 2. Shipping is from Canadian Postal Code R7N 2X8 3. Minimum bid is posted, [b]there is no soft reserve[/b] 4. Payments via paypal. 5. Bids must be in whole dollars in increments of [b]no less than $5[/b] 6. I will combine shipping for multiple successful bids. 7. I can text the winning bidder a picture of the box and tracking number from the post office. 8. I can gm you a shipping estimate if you gm me your postal (zip) code. [b]9. [size=18]Auction ends during the evening of Wednesday Feb 4th 2026[/size]. Closing time left flexible to avoid sniping.[/b]
